title: Tunneler & Machines
description: Automatic programmable machines that create different types of tunnels and more
body:
**_This mode adds few practical machines that help you to dig long underground tunnels._**

Every mychine is in-game programmable with very simple language that consists only of numbers.

_For exmaple: 5;1;5;2;10;3;12;5;2
Explanation: MOVE 5, turn left, MOVE 5, turn right, MOVE 10, go down, MOVE 12, continue forward, MOVE 2_

First and last position must be MOVE call.
Every second position is direction change, 1 stands for LEFT, 2 stands for RIGHT, 3 stands for DOWN, 4 stands for UP and 5 is CONTINUE FORWARD.
In between calls place ";" symbol.
You can create seemingly endless routes with this, but make sure to have enough resources.
When you are done with designing your custom route sign it with name "route.code".
You can now RMB it on every machine in this mod before starting it.

**New blocks:**
-Obtainable
Iron Tunneler
Diamond Tunneler
Railer

-Unobtainable
Torch Marker
Railer Marker

**New items:**
Starter Key
Tunneler Upgrade MK1
Tunneler Upgrade MK2
Iron Drill
Diamond Drill
Track
Miner Core
Builder Core
Machine Manual
